Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes posted G-code.

- Both posts write P0 on each opening G86 block with zero dwell.
- The tests check zero dwell and a change from positive dwell to zero dwell.
- The change keeps the G82 and G89 conditions. It does not change the cycle motion.
- I checked the current upstream AGENTS.md and issue #2362. I found no blockers.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream/main c42eeba78b1078093bcc874f0a560d620e74ffe7 had no conflicts.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2532`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Selected post tests: build with --no-run | Pass |
| Selected app tests: build with --no-run | Pass |
| Quick gate: 130 steps | 130 passed, 0 failed; 9.2 minutes |
| Post suites: 89 steps | 753 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored |
| App suites: 39 steps | 270 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored |
| Post bore_cycle | 9 passed |
| App bore_cycle | 4 passed |
| Clippy: camcraft-post and camcraft-app, --all-targets -- -D warnings | Pass; no warnings |

I repeated both mutation checks:

1. I restored upstream/main's grblhal.cps. `grblhal_zero_dwell_g86_has_p0` failed because G86 had no P0 (exit 101). I restored the fix. The test passed.
2. I restored upstream/main's tormach.cps. `tormach_zero_dwell_g86_has_p0` failed because G86 had no P0 (exit 101). I restored the fix. The test passed.

I checked each changed golden line:

- `crates/post/tests/golden/bore/grblhal.nc:15`: adds P0 to the first G86 block. The next modal hole keeps its X Y block.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/bore/tormach.nc:19`: adds P0 to the first G86 block.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/bore/tormach.nc:25`: adds P0 to the G86 block after G80.

These three lines have no other changes.
The [LinuxCNC G86 reference](https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/g-code.html#gcode:g86) gives the dwell in seconds.
The [grblHAL parser](https://github.com/grblHAL/core/blob/master/gcode.c#L3272-L3291) accepts P0 and requires P when the dwell cycle changes.

Requested before merge: none.

Not tested: physical controllers, the batch gate, and the release gate.
No UI files changed. Before/after screenshots are not required.
